tools.name: merchantpro_list_products
tools.description: List products in the shop with stock and price summary. Filter by status, SKU, EAN, category or tag. GET /api/v2/products.

tools.name: merchantpro_get_product
tools.description: Get one product in full: description, stock, prices, categories, images and variants when requested with include. GET /api/v2/products/{id}.

tools.name: merchantpro_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with their shipping and payment status. Filter by status, customer email, or the date the order changed. GET /api/v2/orders.

tools.name: merchantpro_get_order
tools.description: Get one order in full: line items, totals, addresses, payment and shipping status, invoices. GET /api/v2/orders/{id}.

tools.name: merchantpro_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with login status and order counts. Filter by email or status. GET /api/v2/customers.

tools.name: merchantpro_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer in full: contact, billing and shipping addresses, groups and order totals. GET /api/v2/customers/{id}.

tools.name: merchantpro_update_stock
tools.description: Set the stock level of one product to an absolute value (not a change). Give exactly one of id, sku or ean. Sets stock on the live shop at once. PATCH /api/v2/inventory/stock.

tools.name: merchantpro_update_prices
tools.description: Set the net or gross price, and the old (strike-through) price, of one product. Give exactly one of id, sku or ean and at least one price. The live shop shows the new price at once. PATCH /api/v2/inventory/prices.

tools.name: merchantpro_set_order_status
tools.description: Move one order to in_process, shipped, delivered, returned or cancelled. The customer may get an email (send_email). Cancelling or returning an order can refund or reverse stock in the shop. PATCH /api/v2/orders/{id}/{status}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: merchantpro_list_orders, merchantpro_list_customers, merchantpro_set_order_status · Private data: merchantpro_get_customer · Public sink: merchantpro_list_orders, merchantpro_list_customers, merchantpro_set_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: merchantpro_list_orders, merchantpro_list_customers, merchantpro_set_order_status · Private data: merchantpro_get_customer · Public sink: merchantpro_list_orders, merchantpro_list_customers, merchantpro_set_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
